title: C1452 — Variable Camshaft Timing Bank 2 Solenoid 1 (VCT21)
introduction:
Variable camshaft timing changes when the valves open or close while the engine runs. Its control solenoids work with oil-controlled actuators and the engine controller. I use this connector reference to separate the electrical supply role from the control role—a wiring cast list, with each cavity assigned its own part.

Read the component title alongside the Function wording exactly as printed; this sheet does not explain how those naming labels relate. Gauge conventions and the Size and Used codes remain undefined.
